paragraphs: An E. coli and Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts remains open, with 76 cases across 16 states and 6 hospitalizations reported as of October 1 [1]. Two outbreaks have ended: a Salmonella outbreak tied to jalapeños sickened 488 people across 34 states with 65 hospitalizations before concluding October 2 [2], and an E. coli O145 outbreak from frozen blueberries affected 17 people in 2 states with 6 hospitalizations before ending October 5 [3].

Do not consume bettergoods Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine (22 oz, made in Italy, sold at Walmart nationwide) due to Listeria monocytogenes contamination [6]. Avoid Evergreen Fresh Sprouts LLC Broccoli Sprouts (4 oz clear plastic bags, UPC 838796001051) distributed in Washington due to Salmonella [7]. Stop using Great Value Frozen Organic Triple Berry Blend and Blueberries (10 oz) and Trader Joe's Frozen Organic Mixed Berry Blend (12 oz) because of potential E. coli O145 contamination [17]. Fromagerie Coop de Mean and Belgium Cabricharme cheeses (sliced, through 10/7/2026) contain undeclared egg allergen and were sold in CA, AZ, NJ, MA, RI, CT, and NY [5]. YUPI GOLPE CON TODO SABOR BBQ mixed chips imported from Colombia (60 g foil bags) are recalled for import violations and were found in AZ, CA, CO, FL, IL, KY, MN, and TX [4].

Additional recalls include Nature's Own Hawaiian Bread (20 and 40 oz bags) for undeclared milk [18], Home Grown Green Sprouting Calabrese Broccoli Seeds (8 oz) for potential Salmonella [16], Stewart's Shops ice cream (Heavenly Medley and Vanilla-Chocolate-Strawberry half-gallons) for possible metal [15], Saint Francis frozen pizzas for undeclared soy [21], and WinCo Salsa Bean Dip Trays for recalled peperoncini ingredients [19].
